Definition: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah
BiblicalUsage: mâshîyach is the anointed one, and it gathers kings, priests, and the Messiah into one word. In 1 Chronicles 16:22 God says, touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm, and in 1 Samuel 2:10 the LORD shall exalt the horn of His anointed. In 1 Samuel 2:35 a faithful priest shall walk before His anointed for ever, and in 1 Samuel 12:3 Samuel stands before the LORD and before His anointed. The word is the chosen one, and it finds its full meaning in Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mâshîyach is the heart of the whole Bible. I hold that every anointed king and priest was a shadow of the Anointed One, Jesus, who is my King and my Priest for ever.
